latest.title: WebOS 1, version 1.01, Build 1
highlights: Local .html files open in Edge and finish loading — no more "this page cannot be displayed"
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V / Ctrl+X belong to the window in front, so typing in Notepad is never hijacked
Copying a file onto an existing name asks first: Replace, Keep both, or Cancel
Every Store app icon ships with the PC — the Store no longer loads logos from other sites
